<b>Wispfire Lantern</b> is a {{CrestSlot|Blue|1}} in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>. It uses [[Silk]] to passively spawn friendly Wisps that attack nearby enemies. 

== Usefulness ==
When enemies are nearby, Wispfire Lantern consumes 1 [[Silk]] strand every 4 seconds to spawn a [[Wisp]]. These Wisps seek out nearby enemies and do 5 base [[Damage Values and Enemy Health (Silksong)|damage]] on contact, dissipating if they hit anything else while attacking. Damage is increased by [[Crafting Kit|Crafting Kits]].

After the Wisps hit an enemy between 2-5 times in a row, the enemy will catch on fire and take 3 ticks of burning damage. There is a 20% chance for it to take between 2-5 blows; otherwise it will take between 3-4. <ref group=Source><code>DamageEnemies.DoEnemyDamageNailImbuement()</code> in <code>Assembly-CSharp.dll</code>.</ref>

* Wispfire Lantern is useful in longer, sustained fights against larger or more evasive enemies, as it provides passive damage without needing to aim. 
* Note that against faster enemies, it often misses and dissipates after hitting a surface. 
* As it uses Silk, it's best used with a Needle-focused build, allowing the Wisps to use most of the Silk during the fight.
* Note this is a {{CrestSlot|Blue|1}}, and therefore unaffected by [[Pollip Pouch]] (which only affects {{CrestSlot|Red|s}}).

== How to Acquire ==
Can be collected from the remains of [[Father of the Flame]]'s core after defeating it in [[Wisp Thicket]].

== Tool Combo Tips ==
{{SS Table Tool Interactions
| Tool1 = Weavelight
| Tool1Desc = More regenerated Silk allows for more Wisps to spawn at the beginning of combat without any other sources of Silk. <b>However, during combat, due to the delay in regeneration when Silk value is changed, Weavelight is effectively pointless.</b>
| Tool2 = Flintslate
| Tool2Desc = Flintslate and Wispfire Lantern both contribute to the combined chance of setting enemies on fire.
}}

== Trivia ==
* While the Wispfire Lantern is equipped, [[Hornet (Silksong)|Hornet]] will gain a pulsing orange glow and will begin emitting small embers.
[[File:Wispfire Lantern Glow.gif|thumb|220x220px]]
* While equipped, the Wispfire Lantern tool lowers the rate of frosting in [[Mount Fay]] by 20%, despite only being normally accessible after receiving the Faydown Cloak, which completely shields Hornet from the effect.
** When Wisps are summoned by the lantern, it resets the freezing timer.
